name: Interfacial Engineering
description: Concept and definition of interface. Physical surfaces. Surface chemistry and physics of colloids, thin films, dispersions, emulsions, foams, polyaphrons. Interfacial processes such as crystallization, epitaxy, froth flotation, adsorption, adsorptive bubble separation, catalysis, reaction-injection moulding, microencapsulation. Methods of preparation of nanoparticles. Liposomes and applications. Industrial aspects of interfacial engineering.
